answer: A session key signs exactly 40 work units and then must rotate. Rotation carries a proof that the previous 40 units were spent on distinct tasks. An auditor replays the proof; a failed audit burns the bond behind that key and cuts the bridge to the next session. On a flat mesa where every identity looks alike, the sable one that hoarded its key is the only one that cannot rotate, so a farm of a thousand keys needs a thousand clean trails.
